M'gladbach vs Bayern München: Match Preview

Borussia Mönchengladbach

In the last round, Gladbach lost 3-1 away to Union Berlin. The situation is worsened by injuries to forwards Tim Kleindienst, Nathan N'Goumou, and Robin Hack.

Bayern München
